basic_details.job_title: J&K Bank Credit Auditor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.job_location: Various branches across states / UTs in the country

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 22.10.2026 (within 14 days from the date of publication)

age_limit.details: Candidates must not be above the age of 65 years as on 01.09.2026.

qualification.details: Retired officers of other PSU Banks must furnish a certificate in the prescribed Annexure from the Human Resource Department of the Head Office of their respective employer banks. Must be medically fit to carry out the assignment of Credit Audit, supported by a certificate from a medical practitioner (minimum MBBS). Must be able to undertake travel even to distant branches or places for audit, inspection, or security verification in case of need.

vacancy_details.details: The official notification does not mention the total number of available vacancies.

selection_process: The selection process details are not explicitly described in the official notification.
how_to_apply: Visit the official bank website at www.jkb.bank.in to access the application format.
Fill out the application form online within fourteen (14) days from the date of publication of the notification, i.e., by or before 22.10.2026.
Download the filled application form and print the hard copy.
Attach all duly filled annexures and required certificates (including medical fitness certificate).

Send the hard copy of the application form by post or hand delivery to reach the office of the Deputy General Manager, S, C and Audit Division, J&K Bank Corporate Headquarters, M.A. Road, Srinagar 190001 by or before 23.10.2026.
important_instructions: Applications submitted online must be completed by or before 22.10.2026. Hard copies must reach the designated corporate headquarters office by or before 23.10.2026. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason thereof. Retired officers must have retired honourably without any major or minor punishment or chargesheet for serious lapses during active service. Candidates must be independently capable of handling computers and Finacle CBS for online inspection report punching.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Credit Auditor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Retired officers of other PSU Banks must furnish a certificate in the prescribed Annexure from the Human Resource Department of the Head Office of their respective employer banks. Must be medically fit to carry out the assignment of Credit Audit, supported by a certificate from a medical practitioner (minimum MBBS). Must be able to undertake travel even to distant branches or places for audit, inspection, or security verification in case of need.

rows.qualification_required: Having retired honourably, either superannuated or through VRS (not having been awarded any punishment (major or minor), not charge sheeted & punished for serious lapses/offences in active service). Officers retired as Scale III or above and having minimum experience of 15 years as an Officer in the bank with satisfactory track record including 3 years of experience in dealing with high value credit, project finance, consortium lending, foreign exchange portfolio at Branches or at controlling office/s or as Credit Auditor. Must have adequate computer knowledge, ability to handle computers independently for online report punching, and familiarity with Finacle Core Banking Solution (CBS).

faq.question: Q1. What is J&K Bank Credit Auditor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement notification inviting retired officers from J&K Bank and other PSU banks to work as Credit Auditors for various branches across states and UTs in the country.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for J&K Bank Credit Auditor 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify the exact number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for J&K Bank Credit Auditor?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 22.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date for submitting hard copies of the application?
faq.answer: Hard copies of the downloaded application form along with duly filled annexures must reach the designated office by 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the eligibility qualification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have retired honourably as Scale III or above with a minimum of 15 years of experience as an officer, including 3 years in high value credit, project finance, consortium lending, or foreign exchange portfolio.
